Size guide

All tees are unisex. Measurements are of the garment, laid flat, in centimetres. If you're between sizes, size up for a relaxed fit or down for a closer one — the Oversized Tee already runs one size big.

SizeChest (cm)Length (cm)Shoulder (cm)Fits chest
XS47664281–86 cm
S50694486–94 cm
M53724694–102 cm
L567449102–110 cm
XL607652110–118 cm
XXL647855118–126 cm

How to measure

Take a tee that fits you well, lay it flat and measure across the chest 2 cm below the armholes, then from the top of the shoulder seam to the hem. Match those to the table above.

Shrinkage

Every tee is pre-shrunk; expect at most 2–3% after the first wash if you tumble dry hot. Wash cold and hang dry to keep the exact fit.
